_doc: PROPOSED 2026-11-19; ADOPTED 2026-11-22 (see adopted, and each proposal's live colours). The owner: "ideally we relearn color theory and ad design to maximize all of the color pairs, trios, etc.. that work and keep a viewer captivated.. means vibrant or neon colors often times or really good contrasts"; the roadmap: the owner sees the proposed pairs and trios on real ads before they replace the current ones. Ten new schemes on ten different grounds (complementary, split-complementary and analogous pairs at the most chroma sRGB holds at their lightness), and three of the studio's neon-on-black pairs at full neon. Each passes the floors scripts/build_house_colours.mjs holds every theme to (the words 4.5:1 on the ground and its lit middle, the plate's words 4.5:1, the accent 3:1 on the ground and .3 off it in gamma luminance), and none is within CIEDE2000 14 of another or of a pair the studio has (but the three it would replace). Shown to the owner on the iPhone and the cars full ad. To adopt one: a row in app.js COLOR_THEMES (its group, bg, ink, accent), then node scripts/build_house_colours.mjs.

proposals.name: Yellow on Violet
proposals.why: complementary: violet and yellow, the most contrast two hues give

proposals.name: Electric Blue, White & Orange
proposals.why: complementary: blue and orange at full chroma

live.name: Electric Blue, White & Orange
live.changed: the blue a little deeper and the orange a little lighter, so the money word reads 4.5:1 on both stops

proposals.name: Hot Pink, Black & Cobalt
proposals.why: a neon ground, its cool counter in the plates

live.name: Hot Pink, Black & Cobalt
live.changed: the pink a little lighter, so the cobalt money word stands 1.7:1 off the black words

live.name: Orange, Black & Cobalt
live.changed: the orange a little lighter, so the cobalt money word reads and stands apart from the black words

proposals.name: Red, White & Yellow
proposals.why: analogous warm: the colours of a sale

live.name: Yellow on Red
live.changed: white words cannot stand apart from a yellow money word (theme_law: 1.7:1), so the two-colour sign, the red a little deeper so the yellow reads 4.5:1

live.name: Lime on Magenta
live.changed: white words cannot stand apart from a lime money word, so the two-colour sign, the magenta a little deeper

proposals.name: Yellow, Black & Magenta
proposals.why: a bright ground, a hot accent

live.name: Mint, Black & Violet
live.changed: red on mint is one colour to a red-green colour-blind reader (theme_law: 3:1 under every simulation), so violet

proposals.name: Black, White & Neon Lime
proposals.why: replaces Black & Lime (#8bd737): the lime at full neon

live.name: Black & Lime
live.changed: Black & Lime, its name kept (the business cards read it by key); the lime as far toward neon as white words allow

proposals.name: Hot Pink on Black
proposals.why: replaces Black & Pink: the words in the neon too

live.name: Black & Pink
live.changed: Black & Pink, its name kept; the hot pink as shown, the words white so the money word stands apart

proposals.name: Cyan on Black
proposals.why: replaces Black & Cyan: the words in the neon too

live.name: Black & Cyan
live.changed: Black & Cyan, its name kept; the cyan as far toward neon as white words allow

adopted: 2026-11-22: the owner, "Adopt all 13". Held to the photo ads' law (scripts/theme_law.mjs) as well as the full ad's floors; six were moved the least that passes (see each "live" entry). DESIGN-LAW 154.
